newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi Arabia offers one billion riyals in FRNs.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia offers one billion riyals in FRNs.

text.p: The Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (SAMA) has offered local banks one billion riyals worth of three- and five-year floating rate notes (FRNs), bankers said.
They said SAMA, the kingdom's central bank, issued its second FRN on Saturday. The first FRN issue was on December 28.
The rates for three-year FRNs are fixed at 15 basis points over the Saudi interbank offered rate. The rate for five-year notes is 30 basis points over.
This week's quarterly coupon-fixing would be on Monday and the settlement on Wednesday, bankers said, adding that no government bond issue was made on Saturday.
